newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SHARES MIXED AMID LOW TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SHARES MIXED AMID LOW TURNOVER.

text.p: * Lithuanian Gas declines to 1.66 litas from 1.70 litas.
* Vilniaus Bank eases to 220.00 litas from 225.00 litas.
* Medienos Plaushas jumps to 12.00 litas from 11.10 litas.
* Rokishkis Cheese advances to 43.00 litas from 42.00 litas.
* Brokers see possible gains for official list shares but
slow Tuesday turnover on the central market.
Prices showed a mixed trend on Tuesday but dealers said that many players were waiting on the sidelines as they hope for fresh direction for the market.
"Market participants are staying on the sidelines waiting for a new impetus on the market later this summer," said Kestutis Kupshys, a broker with Mendes Prior Europe.
"I don't think we'll have high turnover today," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema.
Medienos Plaushas jumped to 12.00 litas from 11.10 litas. Rokishkis Cheese advanced to 43.00 litas from 42.00.
The rise in Medienos was expected to boost the official index, along with a gain in Rokishkis to 12 litas from 11.10.
Medienos was given a lift after it said Monday that profit for the first five months of this year edged up to 1.675 million litas from 1.1 million litas in the same period last year.
Elsewhere on the official list, Vilniaus Bank eased to 220.00 litas from 225.00 litas. Prices for Birzhu Milk and Hermis Bank were not set in morning trading.
In group A shares, brokers said Lithuanian Gas, which declined to 1.66 litas from 1.70 litas, might dampen any prospects for gains in that index today.
